comments.body: I have applied for Doctoral Fellowship in Landscape and Architecture studies in ETH Zurich for Fall 2024 entry. It has been approximately one month since I submitted my application on their website. My graduate GPA: 3.80/4.00 and undergrad GPA is :3.3/4.0, I have published two conference proceeding papers during second MS degree study in Urban Planning from US, and I am now waiting for application results. Not receiving any invitation yet. Anyone is in the same boat ?
comments.author: SuperstarRockYou
